name: CRAFT
author: Regis Lloyd Chapman
license: mixed: CRAFT is CC BY 4.0 (inheriting the CSIS publication license); ORE, STRUCK, CROSS, and WALKRI are CC0 1.0
description: The CRAFT family: an evaluation-integrity standards family. CRAFT (Chains Reveal Attested Falsifiable Truth) is the evaluation-chain meta-standard; ORE and STRUCK are its input-stage and exit-boundary companions; WALKRI is the instrumentation standard and CROSS the reporting-outcome standard (the CROSS+WALKRI pair); GRAIN is the primitives layer.

domain.note: The family spans sibling repositories; members are heterogeneous in version source (frontmatter or header) and filename-stem stability. See craft-registry.json.

members.name: CRAFT Specification
members.description: The evaluation-chain meta-standard, Chains Reveal Attested Falsifiable Truth: what a conformant evaluation chain must attest.

members.name: ORE: Origin, Reliability, Exposure
members.description: The input-stage companion to CRAFT: what an evaluation chain may assume about what enters it.

members.name: STRUCK
members.description: The exit-boundary standard: what an output owes before anyone acts on it (Support graded, Traced to origin, Refutation stated, Unjudged worth, Contest kept, Known on its face).

members.name: CROSS: Common Reporting Outcome Standards Schema
members.description: Common reporting and outcome standards schema for grant rounds.
members.note: CROSS is a document cluster (schema, guidance, rubric, templates, worked-examples, canonical-round-configuration-schema, grant-configurator, dashboards, runbooks). The canonical standard document among these is undetermined; this entry provisionally points at the common-reporting-outcome-standards schema. Durgadas's call.

members.name: WALKRI: Working Architecture for Legible, Knowable, Reliable Instrumentation
members.description: Working architecture for legible, knowable, reliable instrumentation; the instrument is the unit of specification.
members.note: WALKRI is a document cluster (WALKRI-standard plus nine companions: guidance, rubric, runbooks, scope, templates, interface-specification, canonical-form-field-profile, CROSS-boundary). This entry points at WALKRI-standard as the canonical document. Durgadas's call.

members.name: GRAIN
members.description: The abstraction and primitives layer for the family. In preparation; not cloned locally, so no version is derived.
